description: Workspace code map: graphs are indexed per mounted repo (scripts/code-map-hook). Workspace freshness: is this clone behind origin's default branch (scripts/check-freshness)

hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -x "$d/scripts/code-map-hook" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -x "$d/scripts/code-map-hook" ] && exec "$d/scripts/code-map-hook"; exit 0
d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -x "$d/scripts/check-freshness" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -x "$d/scripts/check-freshness" ] && exec "$d/scripts/check-freshness" --hook; exit 0
d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -x "$d/scripts/code-map-hook" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -x "$d/scripts/code-map-hook" ] && exec "$d/scripts/code-map-hook"; exit 0
